schema_addition.name: METADATA_SEMANTICS_V2

new_fields.class: MUTABLE_LIVE | IMMUTABLE_FILE (derived from the locator shape)
new_fields.live_sha256: digest of the subject as it exists NOW (files only)
new_fields.subject_exists_now: whether the locator still resolves on disk
new_fields.hashed_at: what the recorded digest means for this class of subject

schema_addition.why_mutable_rows_excluded_from_byte_exac: A `*.db`/`*.sqlite` file or a directory keeps changing after the digest is taken, so `sha256(bytes)` at claim time would not equal the recorded value and any byte-exactness claim built on it would be false. Mutable rows therefore carry `byte_exactness_claim_allowed=false` and must be cited by presence/point-in-time digest only, never for byte-exactness.

claim_ceiling: local metadata classification; NOT an independent acceptance and NOT a claim any subject is frozen
